purpose: Machine-checked source route and shared-surface inventory for the redesign.
statusMeaning: baseline means the current implementation is the recorded starting point; partial means a relevant execution-log slice shipped but the surface work remains incomplete; pending means the redesign spec identifies work with no completion recorded. Complete may be used only with explicit verification metadata. State statuses and source/test references are not visual QA, accessibility sign-off, or screenshot evidence.
familyAuthority: Families are work-planning sections from docs/redesign/SURFACES.md. Public shell surface-class decisions remain owned by surfaceClassFor in apps/web/src/lib/nav/surface-classes.ts and its exhaustive coverage test; this manifest does not reimplement that resolver.
visualBaseline: The screenshot matrix remains the small stable list in packages/testing/src/visual/routes.ts; this inventory does not add screenshot targets.
